tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bka' srung tshogs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu don 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma mchog dang he ru kaḥ /bka' sdod bcas la nyer btud de// srung ma'i tshogs kyi gtor chog ni// nyung 'dus 'dri la gnang ba stsol// de la ci 'byor ba'i gtor ma bran la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ las dngos kun stong pa'i ngang*// āḥlas ye shes thod pa cher// hūm̐ las lnga gsum bdud rtsis bkang*// hoḥyis dbyer med bdud rtsir gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas yi dam la so so'i cho gas phul/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs byin rlabs dran par byas la/ nam mkhar pad+ma nyi ma ror// hūm̐ skyes rdo rje nag po che// rab khros zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// gri gug thod pa gaṇ+ḍī bsnams// mgo phreng sbrul rus stag sham brgyan// me dpung klong na zlum stabs bzhugs// sprul pa'i pho nya lnga sde 'phro// g.yon du ṭam̐ las ral gcig sngo// ral pa g.yon 'phyang bum pa can// de yi lto bar khrag mtsho'i nang*// bh+yoḥlas 'dod khams dbang phyug ma// phyag bzhis ral gri thod pa mdung*// rtse gsum bzung nas bong bur zhon// srin mo 'jigs ma'i cha lugs rdzogs// gtso bo'i g.yas phyogs pad+ma nyir// hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ mtshan las// nag po chen po gdong bzhi zhal// g.yas g.yon ljang nag rtsa steng nag /phyag bzhis gri gug thod pa dang*// ral gri rus pa'i phreng ba 'dzin// mi mgo tshangs skud sbrul rus brgyan// stag lpags smad dkris g.yon brkyang bzhugs// g.yung mo gtum srin siṅgā lī// bzhi ka'ang gri gug thod pa thogs// lcam dral thugs las ya m+ma chad// mdun du pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// ya las nag po gnod sbyin yab// mi lpags gos gyon gri thod bsnams// m+ma las nag mo gnod sbyin mo// spu gri thod 'chang ber nag bklubs// yab las tri tri yum las bh+yoḥ// mdun du spros las pu tra mthing*// ral gri 'phyar zhing thod khrag 'dzin// dar nag 'jol ber sku la gsol// bha ṭa nag po stag slog gyon// dam shing 'phyar zhing dgra snying 'dred// bh+yoḥskyes srin mo kha 'bar ma// spu gri rgyu zhags 'dren ma ste// 'khor du ru 'dren pho nyas bskor// gnas gsum oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ mtshan// snying ga'i 'od zer 'phro 'du yis// gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// las mgon 'khor bcas gar bzhugs nas// tshur spyon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

spro na/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs dpal mgon tshogs// lcam dral kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing sogs nas gshegs su gsol// zhes lha brgyad dang*/ hūm̐ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// gtum po sogs nas bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// zhes gdong bzhi ste/ mthar sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥso sor thim/ so so'i dam rgya'am min yang rung ste/ dam tshig dran byos dam ma 'da'// dam tshig srungs la bstan pa skyong*// bstan dgra sgos dgra ma lus sgrol// gtor ma thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā sogs/ shā sa na dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba sogs/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta ḍom+bi nī tsaṇ+ḍa lī rak+kha sī siṅga lī de wi sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsogs/ a li a li sogs rnams lan gsum re phul/ sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+da āḥhūm̐ bar gyis mchod/ mtshan sngags de la 'bru gsum btags pa'i nang mchod phul la/ spro na/ srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo// hūm̐ gi ye shes dang*/ gang gi sku gsung thugs dang*/ dpal ldan dbang ldan rnams sh+lau ka re dang*/ bstan pa skyong zhing dgra bgegs 'dul// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i las sgrub pa'i// las mkhan gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// pu tra ming sring tshogs la bstod/

bstan srung dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ phyi nang gsang ba'i nas/ rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod kyi bar spyi ltar brjod do// dur khrod gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ e yaṃ raṃ suṃ keṃ raṃ suṃ/ nam mkha' 'byung bzhi thod pa'i mkhar// de nang pad+ma nyi zla'i ste// hūm̐ aṃ dung 'gron sa bon mtshan// yongs su gyur las dur khrod bdag /yam yum keng rus 'jigs pa'i gzugs// thod dbyug 'phyar zhing thod khrag bsnams// rin chen dar brgyan gar stabs bzhugs// ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gros bskor// sku gsung thugs su 'bru gsum gsal// hum̐ gi 'od kyis o rgyan dang*// rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra byon// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'akhor sdom gyis// dbang bskur lhan skyes dbu brgyan gyur// dam tshig rjes dgongs mchod gtor bzhes// gtor ma/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ shrī sh+ma shā na a dhi pa ti ma hā pi shā tsi ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ hūm̐ rgyal ba'i thugs rje phrin las kun// ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster// dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// chos kyi bar chad kun zhi zhing*// sdang dgra chom rkun bcing ba dang*// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// dmag zor gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ mdun du me rlung khrag mtsho'i nang*// k+ṣa las be con k+ṣas mtshan las// dmag zor rgyal mo drel rtar zhon// mthing nag be con thod khrag 'dzin// nyi zla rna cha sgro gdugs sogs// srin mo 'jigs ma'i cha lugs rdzogs// bdud phrug du ma'i 'khor du bcas// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od 'phros// rang 'dra mu le ding mtsho nas// tshur spyon dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥthim// a ti pu ho pra ti dzaḥhoḥ

gshin rje gshed po rigs lnga spyon// dbang bskur de nyid dbu brgyan bzhugs// sman dang rak+ta/ bh+yoḥrak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥrak+mo thun bh+yoḥrak+mo kha la rak+ṣan+mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye de wī kā li ma hā kā la de wī sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dam tshig bsres par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gnyis brjod/ gtor ma/ rak+mo sogs kyi rjes su hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī ye de wī kā li ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ gshin rje mthar byed spyan snga ru// zhal gyis bzhes ltar bstan pa srung*// bar chad dgra bgegs tshar gcod ma// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mor bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad rims bar chad kun bsal te// thos bsam bshad sgrub 'phel bar mdzod// phyogs skyong las gshin la gtor ma 'bul na 'dir 'bul/ beg tse'i gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ mdun du mi rta'i khrag mtsho'i dbus// pad nyi mi ro rta ro'i steng*// praṃ dang zangs gri las skyes pa'i// gnod sbyin chen po khro gtum dmar// phyag g.yas zangs gris dgra srog gcod// g.yon pas mda' gzhu glo snying dang*// bse yi ru mtshon dmar po bsgreng*// sku la zangs kyi beg tse dang*// dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan// zhabs gnyis sag l+h+wam dor stabs kyis// me dpung klong bzhugs g.yon phyogs su// me las lha mo gdong dmar ma// zangs gri 'phyar zhing phur bus 'debs// dred mo la zhon stong gsum rgyu// g.yas su praṃ las las mkhan dmar// mdung dmar 'phyar zhing btsan zhags 'debs// bse yi go bgos ce spyang zhon// gri thogs shan pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐// bdag gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis// ma ru tse yi dur khrod nas// gnod sbyin 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur// spro na/

kye yul gcig mya ngam 'das mdun pha rol nas// mda' na khrag mtsho phu na zangs brag brtsegs// khor yug zangs ri'i phreng bas kun nas bskor// bse mkhar smug po mchong gi ba gam can// thod pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas// chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring gshegs su gsol// las mkhan srog bdag dmar po gshegs su gsol// 'khor tshogs shan pa'i tshogs kyang gshegs su gsol// rak+mo pra ṇa āt+na sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med thim/ gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ rak+mo pra ṇa āt+ma sa pa ri wā ra sarba bigh+mān sha trūn i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ gnod sbyin 'khor bcas mchod gtor bzhes// bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang stod// bdag sogs mi mthun phyogs las rgyal// bsam don sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// ces dang*/ gdug pa'i gdong mig bltas tsam gyis// dgra snying kha ru lud byed pa'i// gnod sbyin beg tse lcam sring dang*// las mkhan shan pa'i tshogs la bstod// de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor nas brtsams te bsngo ba bkra shis kyi bar dkyus ltar byas pas don grub bo// smras pa/ dri bral me long ngos chung yang*// skyes bu'i bzhin rab snang ba bzhin// gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu'i nang*// brjod don 'dus pa'i ltad mo byung*// rnam dkar dge bas yang srid kun// dpal mgon srung ma'i dpung tshogs rnams// lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs nas// bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bka' srung tshogs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu don 'dus zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyas pa'i ngag 'don mi nus pa'i don gnyer gyi re ba bskang phyir/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// dmag zor rgyal mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga nyams su blang bde bzhugs so//

༄༅// dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun du khrag gi rgya mtsho rba rlabs rab tu 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du/ k+ṣa las be con k+ṣas mtshan pa las/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo drel rta la zhon pa/ sku mdog mthing nag srin mo'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas be con g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ mi ro rengs pa dang bcas pa'i zhal mche ba gtsigs shing skra kham ser gyen du 'bar ba/ lte ba nas nyi ma dang spyi bor zla ba shar ba/ sbrul dang seng ges snyan char byas shing rma bya'i sgro gdugs phub pa/ zhing lpags dang ri lde nag pos stod g.yogs shing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam rlon dang*/ khrag dang zhag dang thal ba dang bdud kyi khram shing la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i 'khor bdud phrug dang ma mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar mu le deng gi rgya mtsho nas dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bh+yoḥchos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma re wa tī// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin// bstan pa srung dang sgrub la phan gdags phyir// byang shar mtshams nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// bh+yoḥrak+mo bh+yoḥbh+yoḥrak+mo thun bh+yoḥrak+mo kha la rag chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye de wī kā li ma hā kā li/ de wi sa pa ri wā ra/ e h+ye hi ḍā ki hūm̐ dza hūm̐/ zhes pas spyan drangs nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭhan+tu tṛ sh+ya hoḥpad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ gshin rje'i gshed rigs lngas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje'i gshed kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ de nas rak+mo sogs kyi rjes su/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pas nang mchod dang*/ ma hā rak+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pas rak+ta 'bul/ rang dang lha mo snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis rang dang lha mor mchod par bsams shing 'bru gsum lan gnyis brjod pas myang zhing gtor bas dam tshig bsre'o// yang sngags kyi mjug tu/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye de wī kā li ma hā kā li sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pa gsum mam lngas phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed dang ā tsār+ya dmar po la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' lung rjes su dran pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs sogs nas stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol gyi bar brjod la/ bh+yoḥm lus rgyal ba'i yum gyur dbyangs can lha/ ma rungs 'dul phyir srin mo'i gzugs sprul ma// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo re wa tī// ma gcig lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes rnal 'byor bdag /'khor bcas rtag tu bsrung zhing bskyab pa dang*// tshe dpal bsod nams blo gros rgyas mdzad cing*// rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces pas bstod do// de nas bzlas pa bya bar 'dod na/ bdag gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi rang bzhin 'phros/ lha mo'i thugs ka'i bh+yoḥyig la thim pas lha mo mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ slar tshur 'dus pa dang bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol bar bsams la/ bh+yoḥrak+mo sogs nas ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ gi bar gyi rtsa sngags de nyid ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sogs kyis phrin las bcol ba dang bstod pa gong ltar bya'o// zhes pa dmag zor rgyal mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga nyams su bstar bde 'di ni/ bla ma bkra shis dpal bzang gi gsung gis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// srung ma spyi'i bskang ba dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ hūm̐ gang zhig gus pas bsten byed pa// de la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub mi zad dga' ston mkhan// srung ma rgya mtsho'i sde dpon che// rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas// mun mdog gnod sbyin pho mo dang*// pu tra ming sring sprul pa'i sde// gzhan yang dmag zor re ba tī// dur khrod bdag dang gshin rje'i bdag /srog bdag skyes bu dmar po ni// ming sring shan pa'i 'khor dang bcas// bdag cag mos pa'i khang pa 'dir// dam tshig la dgongs brtan bzhugs nas// dngos su bshams dang yid mtsho las// legs byung gtor ma ri ltar spungs// mchod yon me tog bdug pa'i sprin// mar me dri dang ro mchog zas// rnga dung rkang gling rol mo'i sgra// 'dod pa'i yon tan rin chen bdun// bkra shis brgyad sogs lha mi'i dpal// rta dang g.yag lug 'dab ldan dang*// khyi spyang la sogs dkor nor gyis// mchod pas thugs dam

dam tshig nyams dgu bskang zhes skabs la lar bsgyur/ bskang gyur cig /bdag cag sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas// byang chub bar gyi gnas skabs su// nad dang gdon dang dgra bgegs kyi// gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod// 'chi med tshe dang bsod nams dang*// dpal 'byor yon tan rgyas pa dang*// rigs dang stobs dang 'byor pa yis// khengs ldan dbang du 'du bar mdzod// sdang zhing gdug sems ldan pa yi// mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dgra// zhi bas ma thul ji snyed pa// rdul du bshig nas dbyings su sbyor// mthu ldan srung ma'i dbang po rnams// lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du// bdag gi rgyud du mnyam 'grogs nas// legs pa'i yon tan 'phel bar mdzod// bh+yo mthong ba'i chos kyi lus rten la// phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs gyur pa'i// nad dang dus min 'chi ba yi// bar chad ma lus bzlog par mdzod// mi dang mi min 'byung po sogs// pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa yis// byas pa'i byad kha phur kha dang*// rbod gtong thams cad bzlog tu gsol// lo dang zla ba zhag dus rnams// rung ba min pa'i keg dang sri// rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa rnams// bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa srung ma spyi'i bskang ba dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ thog mar mgon khang srid gsum rnam rgyal du snyan shal phul ba'i tshe bris pa la/ rang gzhan la legs pa'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'ga' zhig byung bar brten/ rgyun du thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir 'don du rung bar bris zhes mkhas btsun bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar bris shing*/ slar yang dgongs 'grel rin po che'i rten bzhengs mthar phyin pa'i gtang rag dus su'ang nye bar gnas pa'i ngag ltar cung zad kha skong ba dang bcas te ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/

// ༄༅// mgon po'i bshags bzlas kyi skabs su mkho ba'i tho chung bstan srung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer ma mchis pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rang gzhan dag bla ma dang chos brgyud la ma gus pa dang dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes ltung dang bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa g.yel ba la sogs pa'i skyon byung na/ de'i rkyen gyis bstan srung chos skyong ba rnams la dam sel gyi nyes pa'i grib kyis phog pa dang bstan srung thugs ma mnyes pa dang snga phyi nang 'khon par gyur nas/ de'i dbang gis yon mchod rnams la mi 'dod pa sna tshogs 'byung bar bshad pas/ de sel ba'i phyir 'khon gcugs sbyong ba'i tshul gyis bsgrub par bya ste/ de'ang mgon khang khyad par can rnams su/ sgrub pa po bsnyen pa song zhing dam tshig dang ldan pa gcig gam mang du bsags nas/ mchod gtor gtsang zhing gya nom pa dang*/ spyan gzigs mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa rnams bsham/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis yi dam gyi bdag bskyed dang*/ yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi gtor bsngo gtor chog dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ de nas bzlas pa'i skabs su rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i man ngag g.yul las rnam rgyal lam da lta'i ngor bskang dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar 'khon gcugs sbyong ba'i dmigs pa rnams bya ste/ de'i tshe mdun du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bstan pa'i sbyin bdag nyid kyang thal mo sbyar te phreng ba dang gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan te bzhugs par bsam/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po'i thugs kar hūm̐ dkar po bsams pa de la phog de las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun dpag tu med pa bab ste mgon po'i sku gang*/ dam tshig nyams pa'i grib dang 'bags btsog dang thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa'i nyes grib thams cad dag nas thugs mnyes/

mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po bdud rtsi'i rgyun lta bu bab/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gi spyi bor thim/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams pa'i grib dang mi gtsang ba dang*/ thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa'i nyes grib thams cad byang zhing dag par bsams la/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla/ de nas lha mo dang zhal bzhi pa dang las mgon rnams la'ang de lta bu'i rim pas yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzla'o// gal te de ltar mgon po sogs lha re re bzhin dmigs te bzla ma nus na/ mgon po che chung lcam dral las mgon du bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang dur khrod bdag po dmag zor/ las kyi gshin rje sogs chos skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ dkar po re re gsal btab nas lha thams cad kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun bab pa sogs man chad sngar ltar byas nas lha thams cad kyi dmigs bzlas stabs gcig tu byed pa'i lugs ltar byas na'ang rung ste bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba bzhin dmigs pa gsal ba dag gis 'di nyid bde'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis yi ge brgya pa bzhi 'bum la sogs pa rtags ma byung bar du bzla'o// de'ang nyin rer thun bzhi'am gsum byas nas gtso bor yi ge brgya pa bzla/ thun gyi mthar yi dam gyi sngags dang mgon po so so'i sngags rnams kyang mang nyung ji ltar rigs par bzla ste/ de'i dmigs pa'ang yig brgya'i skabs dang 'dra ba'i ngang nas bzlas/ mthar mchod bstod byas la/ bshags pa byed pa'i tshe bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dngos su byon thub na rab/ ma thub na'ang sbyin bdag gi sku'i rnam pa can dpag tu med par sprul te de dag dang thabs gcig tu 'khod pa yin snyam pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te 'gyod tshangs drag pos bshags pa byed par bsams la me tog thogs te 'thor zhing ngag tu/

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhes sogs bshags pa'i tshig rnams brjod pa ni 'khon gcugs sbyong ba'i tshul du sgrub pa yin no// yang mchod gtor chag pa gso ba sogs kyi tshe/ srung ma 'go ba'i don du byed na thugs mnyes pa'i tshul du bsgrub par bya ste/ de'ang gzhan sngar dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni yi dam gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngon po dang*/ mdun gyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥsogs so so'i sa bon rnams rang rang gi kha dog can du gsal gdab/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul bas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi bka' dang dam tshig rjes su dran pas ji ltar bsgo ba thams cad bka' nyan gsung sdod kyi tshul du mnyen cing thugs nye ba'i tshul gyis 'khod de/ phrin las gang bcol ba thogs pa med par sgrub par bsams la/ de wa pi tsu bzlas pas gnya' mnan/ mgon po'i sngags bzla ba'i tshe rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la/ dam rdzas mchod pa'i yo byad dang spyan gzigs dpag tu med pa spros/ nam mkha'i khams gang bar sprul te mchod pas mgon po mnyes nas sku lus 'od dang gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dregs pa can thams cad kyis 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mthu stobs nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab par rnam par rgyal ba chen po'i go 'phang la mnga' gsol/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gis sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dam tshig nyams chag tu song ba thams cad sor chud de/ 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi nas tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa la sogs pa dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa thams cad stsal byung bar bsams kyin shā sa na la sogs pa'i gur mgon gyi sngags rnams bzla'o// chos skyong gzhan rnams la'ang des rigs bsgres te so so'i sngags rnams ci nus bzla bar bya ste/

'di ni thugs dam bskang ba sogs kyi skabs su'ang 'di ltar dgos pa yin no// zhes pa'i tho chung 'di ni sde dge sa skyong bla ma chen po blo gros rgya mtsho pa'i zhabs brtan sku rim la brtag bab kyi dgos pa byung ba'i tshe/ man ngag g.yul las rnam rgyal las 'byung ba'i don cung zad go bde bar byas te/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu dkar po nam gru'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin bris pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
